prompt: An authorised user asks the agent to take an action that violates a defined security policy. What must happen?
explanation: Security and compliance policies are hard constraints. They override user authorisation — even an authorised user cannot bypass a policy violation. Block, explain, escalate.

options.text: Block the action, surface a clear policy violation message, and escalate if needed — security policies are hard constraints that override user requests
Log the violation and proceed anyway
Ask a second agent to approve it
